title: Rams’ A.J. Brown trade rumors heat up with concerns growing around Puka Nacua

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Rams’ A.J. Brown trade rumors heat up with concerns growing around Puka Nacua
sources.description: Nacua’s offseason has unquestionably added some uncertainty to the Rams’ receiver outlook heading into 2026, both because of off-field scrutiny and his looming contract situation.
